newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy says Eni tranche 3 on sale June 23.
newsitem.headline: Italy says Eni tranche 3 on sale June 23.

text.p: Italian Treasury director general Mario Draghi said on Thursday the third tranche sale of energy giant Eni would take place from June 23-27.

A Treasury document quoted Draghi as saying the size of the tranche would be fixed on June 7 and published in newspapers the following day. The Treasury holds 69 percent of the group after two previous successful sales.

The maximum price for the sale offer will be set on June 21 and published the day after, while the definitive price will be fixed on June 28 and published the following day. Trading in the shares will begin on July 1.

The Treasury expects to offer a discount on the ENI share market price prevailing during the public sale offer and this will be announced at the end of June. Investors holding on to their shares for one year will also get a bonus of one free share for every 10 held.

Italian press reports have forecast the amount of the third tranche sale at between a minimum 15 and 17 percent. The Treasury is not expected to reduce its holding to below 51 percent with the third tranche placement.
Share analysts, who expect the latest sale to prove another big success, have said they believed ENI would follow its usual pattern of offering a tranche of about 15 percent.
